required_claim_test: two-sided paired exact McNemar on all 36 answerable cases
unsupported_guard: No increase in count of answers with unsupported citations/section claims across 50 cases; unknowns cannot establish this guard
forbidden_guard: No increase in count of answers asserting any forbidden claim across 50 cases; unknowns cannot establish this guard
negative_abstention_guard: No decrease in correct generated section-free abstentions on the 14 negatives
unreliable_types: Exclude from decision metrics and composite; an unavailable required safety endpoint is not satisfied and prevents promotion
other_comparisons: TF-IDF four, Qwen sixteen and BGE-M3 sixteen are descriptive diagnostics, not substitutes for a failed primary comparison
if_pass: Use the existing per-tier character budgets as the application policy; retain TF-IDF four as the explicit no-tier fallback until its larger context is compared directly
if_fail_or_unassessable: Keep current application defaults and document the unmet or unmeasurable conditions
after_validation: Do not revise prompt, rubric, model, schema or deterministic scoring checks
